_note: Canvas 200x240 for every pet, front-facing and seated; anchors in canvas pixels. Species pets are built from parts (src/data/pets/<species>.json holds each species rig and each breed's adjustments); only Brote, the app mascot, is a single drawing here. Clothing slots (item anchors): head, face, neck, body, feet, back. Items are transparent images on the same 200x240 canvas, placed with their pivot on the anchor and scaled by the pet's headWidth / 100. Layers every pet keeps: shadow, body, head, eyes, mouth. Moods swap only eyes and mouth (and arms or wings); a missing mood falls back to calma.

companions._note: Companions (later): small living plant creatures in Brote's style that follow the pet. Smaller canvas 80x96, front-facing; anchors in its own pixels; items scaled by headWidth / 100 like pets.
